repos_data.description: ✨ PTerm is a modern Go module to easily beautify console output. Featuring charts, progressbars, tables, trees, text input, select menus and much more 🚀 It's completely configurable and 100% cross-platform compatible.
A minimal, developer-friendly pretty-printer and debug dumper for Go structs, inspired by Laravel’s dump() and Symfony’s VarDumper.
